title: Atlas Publication Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a Publication (veroeffentlichungen/*.md). Successor of the former Atlas Project entity (atlas.project/1|2) — see ADR-0004. Carries the bibliography (refs as Paper cite keys), the publication lifecycle, links to manuscripts (.tex), originating research projects, derived-from ideas and an optional paper self-link (cite key of the own published PDF in the library). /2 (ADR-0022, issue #205) adds the optional Collection link: a file with collection_id is the Atlas side of a core Collection, its bibliography is that Collection (read live through LibraryApi), so it carries no refs; kind records the entry type (always publication in this folder). /3 adds the optional history (Verlauf): one entry {date, status, venue} per status change, so a rejection and the resubmission elsewhere stay on record.

status.description: Lifecycle planned → drafting → submitted → in-revision → published, plus terminal rejected/withdrawn.

venue.description: Target or actual venue (journal, conference, publisher).

refs.description: Bibliography as Paper cite keys → join to the LocalBib library. Hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired.

derived_from.description: Idea IDs this publication grew out of (link stored downstream, ADR-0004).

projects.description: IDs of the research projects this publication originated from (canonical side of the Project↔Publication link).

paper.description: Cite-key self-link to the own published PDF once imported into the library.

history.description: Verlauf: every status change, oldest first, appended by Atlas on each change; an undo replaces the whole list.

status.description: The status entered on that day.

venue.description: The target (journal, conference, publisher) at that moment.

collection_id.description: ID of the core Collection this entry belongs to (ADR-0022). Its literature list is the Collection, never refs in this file. Removed — and the last membership frozen into refs once — when the Collection is deleted.

kind.description: Entry type of a Collection entry; only set together with collection_id. Atlas stores it, the core knows nothing about it.
